title: Ben Lomond Track: Queenstown area, Otago region
overview: The Ben Lomond Track is a demanding climb and a full day's hike with an 1,438 m elevation gain when completed from Queenstown. On a clear day trampers are rewarded at the summit with spectacular panoramic views.
6-8 hr return to Ben Lomond Summit from Queenstown
Fires are not allowed at any time. See fire rules on conservation land .
In winter you will need to carry and be able to use alpine equipment such as avalanche equipment, ice axe and crampons. The track may change between very slippery and muddy.
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.
